estimate-bias.def: Whether an approximation is too large (an overestimate) or too small (an underestimate) compared with the true value. For a tangent line approximation it follows from concavity.

linearization.def: The tangent line used to approximate a function near a point: $L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)$, so $f(x) \approx L(x)$ for $x$ near $a$. Also called local linear approximation or tangent line approximation.

concave.def: A graph is concave up on an interval where $f'' > 0$ (it bends upward and lies above its tangent lines) and concave down where $f'' < 0$ (it bends downward and lies below them).
